name: cattle-cloudflare
description: Steading — farm management on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter worker dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter worker build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter worker typecheck && cd apps/web && tsc --noEmit
scripts.deploy: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter worker db:migrate && pnpm --filter worker run deploy
